scheme_name: Industrial Skill Development Allowance To The New Employees Employed In Industries In H.p
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh
Must be registered with the Employment Exchanges in Himachal Pradesh
Must be currently unemployed and seeking employment
Preference is given to individuals with limited formal education
Physically challenged individuals with at least 50% permanent disability may receive a higher allowance rate
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly allowance to support Himachali youth while they acquire on‑the‑job skill training, enhancing employability.
documents_required: Form-(i): Application form for the grant of allowance
Certificate of Employment from the competent Officer/Authority of the concerned Industrial Establishment (as per form‑vi)
Affidavit (as per form‑iii) for subsequent months of March
